assessments.table:
CREATE TABLE assessments (
	context JSON NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36), 
	finalize_run_id VARCHAR(36), 
	submission_id VARCHAR(36), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	topic_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	questions JSON NOT NULL, 
	result JSON, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id)
)

attempts.table:
CREATE TABLE attempts (
	elapsed_seconds INTEGER, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	assessment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	question_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	answer TEXT NOT NULL, 
	answer_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	assisted BOOL NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_attempt_revision UNIQUE (assessment_id, question_id, answer_revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(assessment_id) REFERENCES assessments (id)
)

evidence.table:
CREATE TABLE evidence (
	context JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	topic_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	assessment_id VARCHAR(36), 
	attempt_id VARCHAR(36), 
	kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT, 
	error_tags JSON NOT NULL, 
	source_refs JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(assessment_id) REFERENCES assessments (id)
)

graph_revisions.table:
CREATE TABLE graph_revisions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	material_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	material_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	base_graph_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	graph_version INTEGER, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	diff JSON NOT NULL, 
	preparation JSON, 
	publication JSON, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_graph_revision_sequence UNIQUE (material_id, sequence), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_graph_published_version UNIQUE (material_id, graph_version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(material_id) REFERENCES materials (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(material_version_id) REFERENCES material_versions (id)
)

idempotency_keys.table:
CREATE TABLE idempotency_keys (
	`key` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	request_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	resource_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	resource_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	version_id VARCHAR(36), 
	run_id VARCHAR(36), 
	response JSON, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (`key`)
)

knowledge_corrections.table:
CREATE TABLE knowledge_corrections (
	context JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	proposed_value JSON, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id)
)

knowledge_relations.table:
CREATE TABLE knowledge_relations (
	id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	from_topic_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	to_topic_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	relation_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_refs JSON NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	valid_from DATETIME, 
	valid_to DATETIME, 
	recorded_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

learner_states.table:
CREATE TABLE learner_states (
	context JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	topic_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	mastery_score FLOAT, 
	score_validity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	error_tags JSON NOT NULL, 
	state_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	last_assessed_at DATETIME, 
	next_review_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_learner_space_topic UNIQUE (space_id, topic_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id)
)

learning_conversations.table:
CREATE TABLE learning_conversations (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	learning_session_id VARCHAR(36), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(learning_session_id) REFERENCES learning_sessions (id)
)

learning_exports.table:
CREATE TABLE learning_exports (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

learning_messages.table:
CREATE TABLE learning_messages (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	response JSON, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_message_sequence UNIQUE (conversation_id, sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES learning_conversations (id)
)

learning_sessions.table:
CREATE TABLE learning_sessions (
	context JSON NOT NULL, 
	active_space_id VARCHAR(36), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	finished_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_learning_sessions_active_space_id UNIQUE (active_space_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES study_plans (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES study_tasks (id)
)

learning_spaces.table:
CREATE TABLE learning_spaces (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	goal TEXT, 
	target_date VARCHAR(32), 
	weekly_minutes INTEGER, 
	bindings JSON NOT NULL, 
	topic_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	excluded_topic_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	space_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scope_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	profile JSON NOT NULL, 
	profile_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

material_raw_files.table:
CREATE TABLE material_raw_files (
	version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	content LONGBLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (version_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version_id) REFERENCES material_versions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

material_versions.table:
CREATE TABLE material_versions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	material_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	media_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	graph_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(material_id) REFERENCES materials (id)
)

materials.table:
CREATE TABLE materials (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', 
	current_version_id VARCHAR(36), 
	size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

outbox_events.table:
CREATE TABLE outbox_events (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	aggregate_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	aggregate_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	lease_token VARCHAR(36), 
	lease_until DATETIME, 
	available_at DATETIME, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

run_events.table:
CREATE TABLE run_events (
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	data JSON, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (run_id, sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

runs.table:
CREATE TABLE runs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	progress INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	result_ref JSON, 
	error JSON, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	finished_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

session_events.table:
CREATE TABLE session_events (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	client_event_id VARCHAR(128), 
	type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	received_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES learning_sessions (id), 
	UNIQUE (client_event_id)
)

source_chunks.table:
CREATE TABLE source_chunks (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	material_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	section_path JSON NOT NULL, 
	page INTEGER, 
	line_start INTEGER, 
	line_end INTEGER, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(material_version_id) REFERENCES material_versions (id)
)

state_resets.table:
CREATE TABLE state_resets (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	topic_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	state_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id)
)

study_plans.table:
CREATE TABLE study_plans (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	scope_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36), 
	config JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id)
)

study_tasks.table:
CREATE TABLE study_tasks (
	context JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	topic_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	estimated_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	note TEXT, 
	defer_until DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES study_plans (id)
)

topics.table:
CREATE TABLE topics (
	id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	material_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	revision_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	level INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	source_chunk_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	valid_from DATETIME, 
	valid_to DATETIME, 
	recorded_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(material_version_id) REFERENCES material_versions (id)
)
